Switch Loop daemon drive to authorizeBatch (LOOP_DAEMON_ACTOR_ID, tracker_approval or policy_auto, return_policy retain_branch, interaction_mode parent_relayed) + startLanes on creation and advanceLanes(root, batch_id) on every tick and post-decision relay, escalating startup blocked/entry_submitted=false dialogs via planEscalation. Replace exit_recorder.ts in loop_daemon/dispatch.ts PR creation with reading the integrated child commit from the v3 Batch Record and verification_evidence_digest from settled .imm/audit/<task_id>/ on retained refs/heads/imm/<task_id>. Require sessions port on advanceBatch and delete startBatch, batch_runner.ts, lane_supervisor.ts, exit_recorder.ts, tests/lane-supervisor.test.ts, and .imm/state/lane-supervisors/. Accepted regression (D18, OD-6, confirmed 2026-11-18): daemon drive outside Herdr refuses lane_session_unavailable until #495 instead of running --print Executors.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts: with HERDR_ENV=1, HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID=ws1, and an injected herdr adapter behind runtime/lane_sessions/, daemon drive builds its agreement via authorizeBatch (LOOP_DAEMON_ACTOR_ID, policy_auto, retain_branch, parent_relayed) and calls startLanes (passing LANE_EXECUTOR_ENV=headless), calls advanceLanes(root, batch_id) on subsequent ticks (rotating a stalled g1 to g2 without waiting for Kernel settlement, and posting planEscalation when open returns entry_submitted false), removes the Lane worktree and imm-lane/ upon settlement while retaining refs/heads/imm/<task_id>, and opens the PR citing the v3 Batch Record commit and .imm/audit/<task_id>/ verification digest.

In tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts: with HERDR_ENV unset under default config, daemon drive reports lane_session_unavailable and creates zero Lane worktrees, zero sessions, and zero child processes; PR creation in dispatch.ts fails closed when the batch record has no integrated commit or .imm/audit/<task_id>/ evidence is absent (negative controls).

In tests/loop-daemon-decisions.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-dispatch.test.ts: verified GitHub decision and stop replies apply via relayLaneDecision + advanceLanes on the active batch_id; a restarted daemon reconstructs completion and PR eligibility from the v3 Batch Record and .imm/audit/ with zero exit-recorder files; non-drive daemon agents still use agent_runner.

No lane_supervisor.ts, batch_runner.ts, or exit_recorder.ts remains under plugins/immune-brain/runtime and tests/lane-supervisor.test.ts is deleted; zero runtime files mention LaneSupervisor, startBatch, executor_mode, or lane_executor_requires_tui; tests/loop-daemon-boundary.test.ts proves loop_daemon/ imports neither runtime/session/ nor unattended/batch_lanes.ts.

docs/adr/0039-loop-daemon.md Decisions 2 and 14 and docs/adr/0041-simplified-configuration.md Decision 4 describe driving via runtime/lane_sessions/ and gating PRs on Batch Record commits plus .imm/audit/ digests, with zero LaneSupervisor references.

After the retirement: single-task, lane-sessions, cleanup, batch-session-port, agent-roles, daemon, and layering suites pass; Claude bundle, Antigravity artifact, dist mirrors, and typecheck are current.

attestations.summary: Daemon drive now routes through lane_sessions authorizeBatch/startLanes/advanceLanes, LaneSupervisor/batch_runner/exit_recorder retired, PR gated on v3 integrated commit plus .imm/audit digest, executor preference keys renamed; blast radius high: batch_lanes.ts, batch_state.ts persisted executor_preferences, lane_decision.ts, drive_dispatcher.ts, dispatch.ts.

advisory_findings.summary: Legacy executor_model in a stored S5-S7 v3 record's executor_preferences is silently dropped on resume, and mcp_runtime no longer rejects a flat executor_model argument while still rejecting executor_host/executor_effort.

evidence.trigger: v3 batch record persisted before this change with executor_preferences {executor_host, executor_model} → parseBatchExecutorPreferences skips executor_* keys, resumed Lane executor runs without the frozen model; flat executor_model argument to start_unattended_batch → accepted silently instead of 'unknown parameter (use agents)'

advisory_findings.summary: auditEvidenceDigest digests the first run directory under .imm/audit/<task_id>/ in ls-tree order, which can be a stale earlier run when several runs exist, so the PR body may cite a digest not tied to the settled run.

evidence.trigger: .imm/audit/<task_id>/ holding two run directories (earlier stopped run plus the settled one) whose names sort the stale one first → PR body cites the stale run's task-record/terminal-proof digest

findings.summary: LDP-A1 'posting planEscalation when open returns entry_submitted false' is asserted by no delivered test, and the implemented hold path returns a failed job (escalate, never retried) contrary to its own 'retry on a later tick' comment.

evidence.trigger: FakeHerdr open returns entry_submitted:false → dispatchLoopDrive returns hold_for_dialog → enroll_and_drive drive job calls escalateOnce(context,'lane_entry_blocked',...) and returns outcome 'failed' → E12_JOB_FINISHED failed is classified escalate (judgement.ts:344) so the drive is abandoned instead of retried; tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts stops at the hold_for_dialog assertion and tests/loop-daemon-agent-handlers.test.ts stubs deps.drive, so neither the planEscalation comment post/edit nor the resulting job outcome is pinned
